name: @activepieces/piece-anyhook-websocket
description: AnyHook Websocket enables real-time communication through AnyHook proxy server by allowing you to subscribe and listen to websocket events

proxyBaseUrl.description: The URL of your AnyHook server

websocket_subscription_trigger.name: websocket_subscription_trigger
websocket_subscription_trigger.description: Triggers on a new Websocket subscription event

websocketUrl.description: Websocket endpoint URL to connect to.

headers.description: Custom headers for the Websocket connection, such as authentication tokens.

message.description: The message to send to the Websocket server to subscribe to events.

aiMetadata.description: Fires whenever the subscribed WebSocket server pushes a new message to the connection opened by this trigger. The event represents the raw message payload streamed from the endpoint after the subscription message was sent, enabling real-time reaction to live data feeds such as blockchain, market, or collection event streams.
